name: FIPS
label: State + County FIPS code
description: 2-digit State + 3-digit County FIPS code (Federal Information Processing Standard). See also U.S. Census Bureau State & County QuickFacts .

name: TAXPER
label: Ending date for tax period
description: Ending date for tax period of financial data. Core files for 1997 on are in "yyyymm" format (199412=Dec. 1994). Earlier years use 2-digit year ("9412").

name: Filer
label: 990 filing w/n 2 years? (Y/N)
description: Filed 990 return (Form 990, Form 990-EZ, Form 990-PF, or Form 990-N) within 24 months of BMF file? (Y/N)

name: ZFILER
label: 990 filing $0 inc/assets w/n 2 years? (Y/N)
description: Filed 990 return with zero income and assets within 24 months of BMF file? (Y/N) - Beginning 2008, over 95% of 'zero filers' (ZFiler=Y) filed Form 990-N (e-Postcard) for tax years ending on or after December 31, 2007.

name: ntmaj12
label: NTEE major group (12)
description: 12 NTEE major groups: ntmaj10 plus higher education (BH) and hospitals (EH)

name: MAJGRPB
label: Major NTEE group
description: Major NTEE group plus hospitals and higher education

name: INCOME
label: Gross receipts
description: Gross receipts from most recently filed Form 990

name: ASSETS
label: Total assets, end of year
description: Total assets (end of year) from most recent Form 990

name: cFiler
label: 990 filing w/n 2 years? (Y/N)
description: Filed 990 return within 24 months of BMF file date? (Y/N)

name: czFiler
label: 990 filing $0 inc/assets w/n 2 years? (Y/N)
description: Filed 990 return with zero income and assets within 24 months of BMF file? (Y/N) - Beginning 2008, over 95% of 'zero filers' (cZFiler=Y) filed Form 990-N (e-Postcard) for tax years ending on or after December 31, 2007.

name: cTaxPer
label: Ending date for tax period
description: Ending date for tax period of NCCS financial data in yyyymm format.

name: cTotRev
label: Total Revenue
description: Total Revenue from most recent Form 990 (Part I, line 12 on Form 990; Part I, line 9 on Form 990-EZ; or Part I, line 12(a) on Form 990-PF)

name: cAssets
label: Total Assets, BV End of Year
description: Total Assets (Book Value at end of year) from most recent Form 990 (Part IV, line 59(B) on Form 990; Part II, line 25(B) on Form 990-EZ; or Part II, line 16(b) on Form 990-PF)

name: cFinSrc
label: Source of NCCS Financial Data
description: Source of financial data added by NCCS (primarily the most recent Form 990 filing as of BMF date from NCCS Core files)

name: RULEDATE
label: Ruling date (YYYYMM) from IRS
description: Ruling date: year and month of IRS ruling or determination letter recognizing orgs exempt status (YYYYMM)

name: FNDNCD
label: Reason for 501(c)(3) status
description: Reason for & type of 501(c)(3) exempt status including codes for operating and grantmaking foundations, and broad type of public charity

name: randnum
label: Random number between 0 and 1
description: Random number between 0 and 1 used for creating samples

name: LONGITUDE
label: Longitude
description: Longitude of the organization headquarters or address provided to IRS (includes some PO Boxes)

name: LATITUDE
label: Latitude
description: Latitude of organization headquarters or address provided to IRS, including some P.O. Boxes.
